A '''tribe of Tusken Raiders''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], the tribe [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|attacked]] the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the planet in retribution for the theft of several artifacts from a [[Tusken Relic Cave|relic cave]] on the planet. The [[Tusken King]] was their leader.
